📌 pi-lens active — automated checks run on every edit/write; blocking errors (including pre-existing) show inline and must be fixed.
Key tools (see each tool's own description for args):
• lens_diagnostics — source=session reads cache; empty cache ≠ clean; use source=lsp scope=paths for changed files with absent or stale findings (aggregate hosts: lens(action=diagnostics)).
• symbol_search → module_report → read_symbol/read_enclosing — ranked identifier search, then navigable outline/callback handles + exact body reads; cheaper than reading a whole file before editing.
• Situational (activate via pi_lens_activate_tools if unlisted): ast_grep_search, ast_grep_replace, ast_grep_outline, lsp_navigation, lens_diagnostic_mark. Use ast_grep_search dump=true to inspect AST.
